candidates.title: NOVA: Technology-Architecture Co-Design of Near-Memory Processing for Attention-SSM-MoE Hybrid LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Recent near-memory processing architecture for hybrid Attention/SSM/MoE inference with two-tier execution, concrete technology/architecture co-design, and end-to-end throughput, latency, energy, and area evaluation.

candidates.title: A Photonic-CXL Memory Appliance for Scalable KV Cache Management in LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Directly relevant CXL memory-pooling/KV-cache systems work. It characterizes host-memory retrieval and evaluates a 32-TB photonic-CXL shared-memory appliance using emulation/simulation, including multi-turn TTFT impact.
